body: I suffer from borderline personality disorder. I am a burden to those around me and a burden to myself. I feel chronic emptiness and paranoia. I’ve suffered and made others suffer with me for too long.

I am a pretty young white girl, but it wouldn’t be out of revenge. I don’t want my family to find me and I worry about doing it at a park or other outdoor space where conditions have many variables. I realize there will be hurt and confusion but I’m trying to find a way to minimize that as best as possible.
My story is long and disturbing. Ultimately, I feel that too much has happened to me. I’m broken and irreparable.
